description: Fuzzframe runs its drawing, cut-outs, voices and music on fal.ai, and fal's whole catalogue is open to you: search it by words and/or a category (text-to-image, image-to-image, text-to-video, image-to-video, video-to-video, text-to-audio, audio-to-audio, text-to-speech, speech-to-text, vision) and get each model's endpoint id, what it does and its price per unit; with endpoint, one model's details and the inputs it takes. Free. Picture models (text-to-image, image-to-image: drawing, editing, restyling a photo, upscaling, removing a background) run for the film through fal_run; the other kinds are listed so you know what exists.

endpoint.description: One model's endpoint id: its details, price and inputs instead of a search

limit.description: How many models to list, 1 to 30
